Variants.Content: Fort Rathylar is located in the old land of Sanor on the northern edge of the Dothraki Sea. Politically, it is within the area where the remnants of Sanor, the steppe tribes and the remaining towns intersect. It is a castle mainly responsible for local garrison, tax collection and sheltering the nearby population. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.

The people near Lotzla Fort seldom talk about borders. What they deal with every day is well water, stalls, food prices, wages and roads to the market. Local families also relied on pastures, ruined wells, horse teams, remaining fields and defense khalasas; if any road, well or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.
